components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled white-on-black pill. Single primary CTA per surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New card</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #fafafa; color: #0a0a0a; font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.005em; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25) inset, 0 8px 24px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.92); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35) inset, 0 12px 32px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(250 250 250 / 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Translucent glass pill. Default secondary action, toolbar selectors.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #fafafa; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%); transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.085); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(250 250 250 / 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No background at rest, faint text. For toolbar verbs and tertiary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: transparent; color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.6); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(250 250 250 / 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Glass input with hairline border, cyan focus glow on user gesture.
components.css: .ds-input { display: inline-flex; height: 40px; width: 280px; padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #fafafa; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.35); font-style: italic; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: rgb(0 229 255 / 0.6); background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.085); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(0 229 255 / 0.20), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Mono uppercase label pill. Filters, IDs, status, ordinals.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.085); color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.6); font: 500 0.625rem/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-chip[data-active="true"] { background-color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.10); border-color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.4); color: #fafafa; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Workflow state indicator. The only fully saturated chroma in idle UI.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.085); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); font: 500 0.625rem/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #fafafa; } .ds-status-pill[data-status="todo"] .ds-status-dot { background-color: #94a3b8; } .ds-status-pill[data-status="in-progress"] .ds-status-dot { background-color: #f59e0b; } .ds-status-pill[data-status="review"] .ds-status-dot { background-color: #38bdf8; } .ds-status-pill[data-status="done"] .ds-status-dot { background-color: #22c55e; } .ds-status-pill[data-status="blocked"] .ds-status-dot { background-color: #fb7185; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.css: .ds-bar { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(250 250 250 / 0.3); background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #fafafa; font: 500 0.75rem/1 Geist, sans-serif; cursor: grab; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); user-select: none; } .ds-bar:hover { border-color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.6); } .ds-bar-stripe { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; border-top-left-radius: 10px; border-bottom-left-radius: 10px; background-color: #fb923c; pointer-events: none; } .ds-bar[data-priority="p0"] .ds-bar-stripe { background-color: #f87171; } .ds-bar[data-priority="p1"] .ds-bar-stripe { background-color: #fb923c; } .ds-bar[data-priority="p2"] .ds-bar-stripe { background-color: #fde047; } .ds-bar[data-priority="p3"] .ds-bar-stripe { background-color: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.5); } .ds-bar-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #f59e0b; margin-left: 6px; } .ds-bar-title { padding-left: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A dimly lit studio console for an internal team. Black surfaces, white ink, no decoration that does not earn its keep. The tool fades into the background of the work; what remains visible is the work itself. Color is reserved for status (the workflow needs a signal) and for the result of a deliberate gesture (a save lands, a drag commits, an error fires). Everything else is grayscale by doctrine.

The system is monochrome by default, not by accident. Card titles, labels, lists, columns, sidebars, headers: all white-on-near-black. The five accent colors that historically existed in the codebase (cyan, magenta, violet, lime, amber) are flattened to white in idle UI. They are kept as named tokens so they can be summoned for specific high-information surfaces (focus glow rings, charts, drag-source previews) without polluting the everyday palette. The palette is exactly two ideas: ink and surface.
keyCharacteristics: Black-and-white discipline: any color in idle UI is a bug, not a feature.
Glass is structural, not decorative: surfaces are translucent only when they overlay other content.
Density tolerated: row heights tight, label text 11px mono, monospaced metadata everywhere.
Status colors are the only sanctioned chroma: five workflow tokens plus five priority dots.
Hierarchy is structural: filled white pill = primary, glass pill = secondary, ghost = tertiary.

rules.name: The Idle Mute Rule
rules.body: Idle UI is grayscale. If a screen is at rest and it carries a saturated color anywhere outside a status pill or a priority dot, that color is wrong. Color is feedback, not decoration.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders and dividers default to --hairline (#ffffff1f, 3.05:1). Never below; that fails WCAG 1.4.11 for non-text UI.

rules.name: The Solid Popover Rule
rules.body: Floating panels (dropdown menus, popovers, banners, tooltips, bulk action bar) are opaque (--popover, #1f1f1f). Translucent glass on a floating panel masks the content beneath; we forbid it.

rules.name: The Mono-Meta Rule
rules.body: Every machine-generated label (IDs, ISO dates, ordinals, ENUM values) is mono, 11px or 10px, uppercase, 0.08em+ tracking. Human content is sans, sentence case.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Display, headline, title, body all share Geist. Hierarchy is weight + size + tracking, not a different face. Geist Mono and Instrument Serif carry strict roles; do not introduce a fourth family.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on lifted elements (glass cards, dialogs) and on response-to-state (drag, focus). Never as decoration.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Structural Rule
rules.body: glass, glass-strong, glass-hi are reserved for surfaces that overlay content underneath. Forbidden as decorative atmosphere on full-bleed sections, hero panels, or anything that does not literally float above other content.

dos: Do use --popover (#1f1f1f) opaque for every floating panel.
Do lift glass cards with glass utilities only when they literally float above other content.
Do carry every machine-fact in mono 10-11px uppercase with 0.08em+ tracking.
Do use status colors only inside status pills, list status_kind swatches, and Gantt cell fills.
Do carry priority as a 4px left-edge stripe (gutter band) or a 2px dot inside a chip.
Do pair every status / priority signal with a non-color cue.
Do keep hit targets at >= 32px on primary controls and >= 24px on dense affordances.
donts: Don't use Trello card-on-blue, Asana rainbow status pills, Monday candy blocks, Jira enterprise blue, Notion soft gray-on-gray, or the Linear purple-magenta gradient.
Don't use side-stripe borders >1px as a colored accent on cards, alerts, callouts, or list items.
Don't use the same chip class for both buttons and state pills.
Don't colorize a row, lane, or column to indicate priority.
Don't use border radius below --radius-sm (8px) on any container surface.
Don't use em dashes anywhere in UI copy.
Don't wrap floating action chrome in glass.
